title: Bluewater Bliss
meta_description: Stylish 4BR home for 10 with 2 living rooms, arcade, bikes \& porch---near beach \& dining. Experience this and more at Bluewater Bliss!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Step into your very own oasis of "Bluewater Bliss", where every moment is infused with the essence of relaxation and joy. Nestled amidst the picturesque landscape of Blue Mountain Beach, this charming new beach home beckons you with its promise of tranquility and comfort. With ample space to accommodate up to 10 guests, it serves as the perfect sanctuary for families and friends alike. Located in the heart of one of 30A's newest communities, this stunning beach retreat boasts a backyard porch that invites you to immerse yourself in the beauty of the outdoors. Picture yourself grilling the day's freshly caught seafood while laughter fills the air and memories are made. Whether you choose to spend your days soaking up the sun on the pristine shores or strolling along the sandy white beaches in search of the perfect sunset, every moment promises to be unforgettable. Inside, the home reveals itself as a haven of comfort and entertainment. Two distinct living areas cater to both adults and children, ensuring that everyone finds their own slice of paradise. While the grown-ups unwind in one space, the kids can indulge in endless hours of fun in their dedicated area, complete with an arcade game that sparks excitement and laughter. From the moment you step foot into "Bluewater Bliss", you'll find yourself swept away by its undeniable charm and the promise of unforgettable moments spent in the company of loved ones while enjoying life's simple pleasures.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is a quaint coastal community along 30A between Grayton Beach and Gulf Place. Known for it's laid back vibe yet with all the amenities we look for in a beach vacation. Just steps to the Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access and lots of restaurants like Red Fish Taco, and the Blue Mountain Creamery (best ice cream) nearby. And if you love cinnamon rolls, grab a cup of coffee and a cinnamon roll from Blue Mountain Bakery, you won't regret it. What more could you ask for on your 30a vacation....biking or short golf cart ride distance to the beach and ice-cream!

BEACH ACCESS: Just a quick bike or golf cart ride from the house to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access. There are restrooms, shower, some parking and coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Bedroom 1 -- King bed, ensuite bathroom Tub \& Shower -- 1st Floor
- Bedroom 2 -- King bed, ensuite bathroom w/shower -- 2nd floor
- Bedroom 3 -- King bed, Full Hallway Bath w/shower -- 2nd Floor
- Bedroom 4 -- Bunk Room Twin/Twin Ensuite w/shower -- 2nd Floor

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
- 2 Living Room (2nd Floor Living Room w/Arcade Game)
- Natural Gas Grill
- 2 adult bikes
- 6-seater golf cart
- Coffee Maker - Drip \& Pod
- Full size washer and dryer
- Full linen package: bedding, bath \& beach towels
- Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This property comes with two (2) designated parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
